title: Reducing the Lipschitz Constant in Tseng Algorithm and the Convergence Analysis
summary: In this paper, we prove the weak and linear convergence of Tseng algorithm applied to the zero of sum of two operators problem where each operator is not necessarily monotone while existing researches in the literature require the monotonicity of both operators. Consequently it allows us to decompose more efficiently and can reduce the Lipschitz constant significantly, which is meaningful especially in big data. Numerical examples supporting the theoretical results are also provided.
